releaseTitle: Coffeely v2.4.5 — Pre-Login Mobile UX & Responsive Redesign
releaseNotes: 📱 Zero Navbar Squashing: Clean dedicated mobile login and registration views
🔙 Fast Home Return: Instant '← Back to Home' button on Auth pages
🎯 Mobile Streamlined Hero: Instant access to Coffeely actions without oversized mockups
🎂 Native Date Selection: Responsive wheels for Day, Month, and Year on mobile
👤 Flexible Registration: Single name support and auto-formatted 10-digit phone input
✨ Professional Modals: Native-style 'Sign In to Connect' bottom sheet replacing browser alerts
